title: The Clean Slate
story:
A teacher wrote a difficult math problem on the classroom board.

As students tried to solve it, the board became filled with wrong answers.

Numbers covered every corner.

Mistakes were everywhere.

At the end of the lesson, the teacher quietly picked up an eraser.

With a few gentle strokes, every mistake disappeared.

The board became clean again.

The teacher smiled and said,

“Now we can begin again.”

One student asked,

“Where did all the mistakes go?”

The teacher replied,

“They're gone. You don't have to keep looking at them.”

In life, we often carry the weight of our past mistakes.

We replay them in our minds.

We wonder if God still remembers them.

But when we repent and return to Him, God forgives completely.

He wipes away our sins like clouds disappearing from the sky.

He gives us a fresh beginning because He has redeemed us.
life_lesson: God doesn't simply cover your sins—He removes them and welcomes you back with grace.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your amazing forgiveness.

Thank You for removing my sins through Your grace.

Help me to stop living under the weight of my past.

Teach me to return to You with confidence, knowing You have redeemed me.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you still holding on to mistakes that God has already forgiven?

What is keeping you from fully returning to Him?

How can you walk today in the freedom of His forgiveness?
verse:
I have swept away your offenses like a cloud, your sins like the morning mist.
Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.
